firm_data.firm_name: Weber Gallagher Simpson Stapleton Fires & Newby, LLP
firm_data.firm_description: Weber Gallagher delivers high standards in legal work and client-service. The firm provides legal counseling and representation to local, national, and international clients.
notable_facts: The firm has 13 offices throughout the Mid-Atlantic and Midwest United States and South Florida.
Weber Gallagher was founded in the early 1990s.
Several of the firm's lawyers have become judges.
technology_signals: Moved to a cloud-based environment using SaaS products.
Utilizes cloud-based platforms such as Microsoft 365, Teams, Azure, iManage, and Aderant.
Uses threat detection and vulnerability scanning products and a 24/7 network operations center.
Internal Artificial Intelligence task force is investigating ways to use AI.

ai_contact.ai_notes: The firm’s internal Artificial Intelligence task force is looking to the future, investigating the best ways to safely and responsibly use AI to increase efficiencies and better service our client’s needs.

additional_contacts.name: Paul M. Fires
additional_contacts.title: Firm Chair Emeritus & Workers’ Compensation Co-Managing Partner

email.subject: AI for Weber Gallagher, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Greg,

I saw that Weber Gallagher's internal AI task force is investigating ways to safely and responsibly use AI to increase efficiencies across your 130-attorney practice. That kind of intentional approach to AI adoption is exactly what separates firms that scale from those that get left behind.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to the Mid-Atlantic. I'd be happy to stop by your office to show how we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw, especially in workers' compensation and employment law where document review and case analysis matter most.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
